body: The personal-library removal confirmation unconditionally said the next e-reader update removes the book. OBSERVED on origin/main: Kobo native sync emits a removed entitlement, including shelf-only sync; OPDS drops the catalog/acquisition path; KOReader/KOSync keeps the local file and progress row; an account with no reader only loses membership and ordinary shelf links. Fix replaces the generic device claim with client-specific Classic/SPA copy and compiled fr/nl translations.

resolution.note: Fixed on fix/personal-library-removal-copy with per-client Classic/SPA copy, behavioral coverage, and compiled fr/nl translations.

title: My Library removal dialog falsely says every e-reader deletes the book
